searching: `gYou carefully stealth through the thick bushes searching for danger...`w
encounter_start:
`wYou stand face to face with a {enemy}!

`w
no_turns: `4You have no turns left for today!`w
enemy_defeated:
`2You defeated the {enemy}! `w
You earn `y{gold} gold `wand `c{xp} experience`w!
player_died:
`4You succumbed to your injuries caused by the {enemy}... You are DEAD! `w
You lose all gold on hand.
round_continue:
`2You attack and deal {damageDealt} damage to the {enemy}.`w
The {enemy} {attackText} and deals `4{damageReceived} damage`w back!
flee_success: `gYou run away fast and safely escape the {enemy}!`w
flee_failed: `4Escape failed! The {enemy} blocks your path and deals {damage} damage during your flight attempt!`w
flee_death: `4You succumbed to your injuries... You are DEAD!`w
skill_magic: `cYou cast the spell Regeneration! A mystical light surrounds you and heals {amount} HP.`w
skill_thieving: `yYou use your Pickpocket skill during the attack and knock {amount} extra gold pieces from the {enemy}!`w
skill_warrior:
`rYou execute a brutal Shield Bash! You slam full into the {enemy} and deal {amount} GUARANTEED damage!`w
The {enemy} is dazed!
skill_already_used: `4You have already used your special skill in this fight!`w
skill_warrior_1: `pYour eyes glow purple for a moment. You force {enemy} to look directly into your dark gaze, making a cold shiver run down its spine and causing its attack to miss.`w
skill_warrior_2: `pBlack, tendril-like shadows shoot up from the forest floor. They grab the ankles of {enemy} and pull it painfully to the ground.`w
skill_warrior_3: `pYou raise your hands and mutter a chilling, dark incantation. A purple aura envelops {enemy} and its muscles begin to weaken in real-time.`w
skill_warrior_4: `pYou send a telepathic, terrifying scream straight into the mind of {enemy}. The creature shrinks back in panic.`w
skill_warrior_5: `pWith a snapping hand gesture, you manipulate gravity around the monster. You hear a dull CRACK in the joints of {enemy}.`w
skill_warrior_6: `pA beam of jet-black energy shoots from your fingertips and bores into the chest of {enemy}. You feel its life energy flowing into your veins!`w
skill_warrior_7: `pYou curse your enemy's blood. The wounds of {enemy} spontaneously begin to bleed more heavily with every movement it makes.`w
skill_warrior_8: `pYou strike invisibly at the creature's soul. {enemy} lets out a bone-chilling cry as if being torn apart from the inside.`w
skill_warrior_9: `pYou summon a temporary, shadowy hand from the underworld that delivers a heavy blow to the jaw of {enemy} with brute force.`w
skill_warrior_10: `pA barrier of black flames surrounds your body. Every time {enemy} hits you, half of the damage reflects directly back at it.`w
skill_warrior_11: `pYou dissolve into the shadow, appear behind {enemy}, and deliver an icy blow that transfers its vital functions straight to your HP bar.`w
skill_warrior_12: `pYou spew a greenish, poisonous mist. {enemy} begins to cough heavily and loses its concentration to attack this round.`w
skill_warrior_13: `pDozens of rotting arms break through the forest floor and pull {enemy} down harshly, trapping it in the mud.`w
skill_warrior_14: `pYou absorb all light in the immediate vicinity. In the absolute darkness, you blindly land three razor-sharp strikes on {enemy}.`w
skill_warrior_15: `pYou briefly summon the phantom scythe of Ramius. With a monumental swing, you cut right through the defense of {enemy}. The creature collapses, terminally ill.`w
skill_magic_1: `cYou whisper a soft prayer to the trees. A warm, green glow envelops your sword and restores a small part of your strength.`w
skill_magic_2: `cFast-growing, razor-sharp thorn vines shoot up around your armor. When {enemy} tries to hit you, it pricks its own fingers!`w
skill_magic_3: `cA sudden, fierce gust of wind swirls around the battlefield. {enemy} gets a mouthful of sand in its eyes and misses its attack completely.`w
skill_magic_4: `cYou stamp your foot on the ground. Thick tree roots shoot from the earth and clamp around the legs of {enemy}, leaving it unable to move a step.`w
skill_magic_5: `cYou invoke the healing saps of the forest. A soft glow closes your superficial scratches and cuts in real-time.`w
skill_magic_6: `cYou summon the power of the deep rocks. Your skin and armor temporarily harden into solid granite, making the blows of {enemy} deflect dully.`w
skill_magic_7: `cYou raise your hands and channel a bright beam of pure sunlight straight into the eyes of {enemy}. The creature recoils blinded and roaring.`w
skill_magic_8: `cA magical water spring wells up at your feet. The water washes all toxins and fatigue from your body, leaving you full of energy again.`w
skill_magic_9: `cWith a furious gesture, you point to the sky. A bright, blue bolt of lightning cleaves through the trees and strikes {enemy} with a loud bang!`w
skill_magic_10: `cThe ground beneath you opens slightly and restores a gigantic portion of your health. You feel the pure life force of the planet rushing through your veins.`w
skill_magic_11: `cA raging mini-tornado begins spinning around you. All physical attacks from {enemy} are simply flung away by the wind.`w
skill_magic_12: `cHundreds of hypnotizing, glowing wisps surround the head of {enemy}. The creature flails wildly in the air at the lights and forgets to attack you.`w
skill_magic_13: `cYou summon the phantom form of a gigantic, walking tree. The tree delivers a heavy blow that presses {enemy} deep into the mud.`w
skill_magic_14: `cBeautiful, dancing northern lights illuminate the dark forest. Your attack power and defense are temporarily doubled by this cosmic energy.`w
skill_magic_15: `cYou fuse completely with the elements. Earth, wind, fire, and water burst forth simultaneously around {enemy}. The forest itself demands your enemy's destruction!`w
skill_thieving_1: `yWith a lightning-fast movement, you distract {enemy}. While it looks to the left, you quickly snatch a few extra coins from its fur/pockets.`w
skill_thieving_2: `yYou throw a small pellet of clove and ash on the ground. A dense cloud of smoke appears, causing {enemy} to miss its attack while coughing.`w
skill_thieving_3: `yYou wait until {enemy} drops its guard and deliver a low, painful kick below the belt. The creature cowers in pain.`w
skill_thieving_4: `yYou quickly grab a handful of sharp forest sand from the ground and throw it straight into the eyes of {enemy}. It thrashes wildly and blindly!`w
skill_thieving_5: `yYou make a nimble feint, glide feather-light past the side of {enemy}, and pull its entire pouch loose with a grin!`w
skill_thieving_6: `yWhen {enemy} unleashes its heavy attack, you drop flat onto the ground and nimbly roll under its claws. Complete miss!`w
skill_thieving_7: `yYou kick the tip of your boot against a protruding tree root, sending it shooting right in front of the feet of {enemy}. It stumbles hard forward.`w
skill_thieving_8: `yYou quickly draw a small vial of green poison along the edge of your weapon. Your next scratch on {enemy} immediately begins to burn painfully.`w
skill_thieving_9: `yYou whistle loudly and point to the trees behind the monster. 'Look out, a bigger dragon!' {enemy} falls for it and looks around, giving you a free hit.`w
skill_thieving_10: `yYou seek the weak spot in the natural armor of {enemy}. With a surgical cut, you inflict a deep wound that keeps bleeding.`w
skill_thieving_11: `yYou make use of the flickering shadows of the leaves and vanish from sight. A fraction of a second later, you suddenly stand behind the monster.`w
skill_thieving_12: `yWith a deft tap of your own weapon against the joint of {enemy}, you cause it to drop its weapon/club for this round.`w
skill_thieving_13: `yYou hold your breath and move completely soundlessly. You emerge from a blind spot and deliver an icy, critical strike.`w
skill_thieving_14: `yYou cast a flashbomb on the ground. While {enemy} stands spinning, disoriented, you plant your weapon deeply and mercilessly into its unprotected back!`w
skill_thieving_15: `yYou have become a shadow. You move so fast that {enemy} is fighting against its own shadow, while you assault it with blows from all sides simultaneously!`w

leprechaun_desc: `gYou walk along a narrow path when suddenly a small man in a bright green suit jumps in front of you. 'Hahaha! A traveler!' he giggles. 'Shall we play a game for gold?'`w
leprechaun_success: `2The leprechaun throws a magic die. You win! He makes a face and throws a heavy bag of gold at your head.`w
leprechaun_fail: `4The leprechaun wins by cheating! He takes your gold coins, gives you a hard kick to the shins and runs away laughing.`w
hedge_wizard_desc: `gAmong the thick vegetation you see a wooden hut with purple smoke. An old wizard is stirring a cauldron. 'Ah, a traveler. Taste my newest brew. It is... mostly safe!'`w
wizard_success: `2You take a sip of the glowing blue drink. It tastes like mint and lightning. You feel a massive surge of energy!`w
wizard_fail: `4You take a sip and immediately your stomach tightens in a cramp. You start seeing green and have to lean against a tree.`w
merchant_wagon_desc: `gYou come across a wreckage. A wooden merchant's wagon has tipped over. There are several wooden chests half buried under the debris.`w
wagon_search: `2You take the time to carefully clear the debris. You find a hidden compartment with gleaming gems!`w
wagon_smash_success: `2You kick the largest chest into splinters in one blow. A big stack of gold coins rolls across the ground!`w
wagon_smash_fail: `4You strike wildly at a chest, but trigger a hidden thief trap! A crossbow fires a bolt right into your arm!`w
white_hart_desc: `gOut of the mist steps a beautiful, glowing white hart with antlers of silver. You feel a deep, magical presence.`w
hart_success: `2You make a deep bow. A warm glow descends upon you. All your wounds close immediately.`w
hart_fail: `4You rush towards the creature. The hart disappears in a flash. A voice thunders: 'Greedy mortal!' You feel a heavy blanket of bad luck.`w
card_shark_desc: `gAt a rickety table sits a dwarf with a thick cigar. 'Ah, a traveler! Sit down, take a gamble for a gem. Higher or lower?'`w
card_success: `2The dwarf flips the cards. You are right! He curses under his breath and slides the loot towards you.`w
card_fail: `4The dwarf laughs loudly as he sees your card. 'Too bad, that gem is mine!' He packs his things and disappears.`w
fountain_desc: `gYou stumble upon a beautiful, hidden fountain. Above the fountain hangs an inscription: 'Only one sip brings strength of yore, but drink too deep and you are no more.'`w
fountain_success_heal: `2The water tastes like fresh morning dew. You feel immediately refreshed and all your wounds are healed!`w
fountain_super: `2A magical shock goes through your body! Your muscles swell and you feel permanently more vital!`w
fountain_curse: `4You drink too much and suddenly shrink! You feel weak and your weapon is suddenly way too heavy.`w
fountain_wash: `2You dip your weapon into the water. The runes light up brightly. Your sword feels sharper!`w
fountain_leave: `wYou don't trust it and carefully walk further through the bushes.`w
talking_tree_desc: `gA deep voice sounds from an old willow. 'Halt, mortal. Give me some gold to quench my thirst, and I will tell you a secret...'`w
tree_success: `2The tree rustles contentedly. 'Thank you. The monsters at your level are careless today... I will show you the paths.'`w
tree_fail: `4You strike meanly at the trunk. The tree lets out a furious cry and drops a gigantic branch on your head!`w
giant_desc: `gIn front of you lies an enormous giant loudly snoring. Beside his hand lies a bassinet filled with gleaming treasures.`w
giant_sneak: `2You hold your breath and sneak on your tiptoes past the giant. You learn a lot from this cautious action!`w
giant_steal_success: `yWith velvety fingers you cut the pouch loose. You steal gold and a gem without him waking up!`w
giant_steal_fail: `4Crack! You step on a twig. The giant wakes up furiously and gives you an enormous slap!`w
ruined_temple_desc: `gBetween the tangled vines you find the remains of an ancient temple. On an altar lies a dusty, old book gleaming.`w
temple_read_success: `2The magic letters dance before your eyes and fill your mind with ancient combat techniques!`w
temple_read_fail: `4As soon as you touch the book, black smoke escapes and hits your lungs. It is a dark curse!`w
temple_search: `2You root through the stones of the altar and find a hidden compartment with old coins!`w
travelling_herbalist_desc: `gA woman with a backpack full of jars crosses your path. 'Hello! Fancy a gamble? One elixir heals, the other is... experimental. Which do you choose?'`w
herbalist_red_success: `2The red drink tastes like strawberries. All your wounds close immediately!`w
herbalist_red_fail: `4It burns in your throat! You spit fire and feel weak from the poison.`w
herbalist_blue_success: `2A fresh wind seems to blow through your head. You suddenly feel super fit!`w
herbalist_blue_fail: `4Your eyes become heavy as lead... You fall asleep on the spot and wake up only hours later.`w
scholar_badger_desc: `gOn a log sits a badger with a tiny pair of glasses. 'Tell me, are you here to slay monsters or do you also know something about history?'`w
badger_success: `2You answer the cryptic question correctly. The badger nods. 'Impressive. Here, a reward for your intellect.'`w
badger_fail: `4The badger turns out to have razor-sharp claws and gives you a mean scratch on your hand!`w
skeleton_armour_desc: `gAgainst a tree leans a skeleton in gleaming armour. Do you dare to plunder the armour?`w
skeleton_success: `2You carefully unscrew the breastplate. It fits perfectly and is a significant upgrade for your defense!`w
skeleton_fail: `4As soon as you pull on the plates, the angry ghost of the knight shoots out of the skeleton and throws you back!`w
skeleton_respect: `2You make a respectful bow. You feel a warm wave of gratitude and renewed courage.`w
dark_carnival_desc: `gIn the middle of the forest stands a carnival wagon. A man in a top hat beckons you. 'Come see! Test your luck at the Wheel of Fortune! One spin for 200 gold!'`w
carnival_grand: `2The arrow stops on the grand prize! The director hands you gleaming gems!`w
carnival_consolation: `wThe arrow stops on a consolation prize. You get your gold pieces back.`w
carnival_fail: `4Ouch, too bad! A boxing glove shoots out of the wheel and hits you right in the stomach.`w
abandoned_camp_desc: `gYou find a campfire with a pot of delicious smelling soup. No one is in sight.`w
camp_eat: `2It is a hearty meat soup that immediately fills you with strength and energy!`w
camp_search_success: `2In one of the sleeping bags you find a forgotten pouch with gold!`w
camp_search_fail: `4You root through a chest, but a venomous forest adder bites your hand hard!`w
wishing_well_desc: `gIn a clearing stands an old wishing well. 'Offer a gem for luck, or steal from the well and your day will be hell.'`w
well_success: `2The water pulses with a golden light. You feel a deep blessing descend upon you.`w
well_fail: `4The water turns into boiling acid and splashes in your face! 'Thief!' echoes a voice.`w
honey_tree_desc: `gHigh in a tree you see a gigantic honeycomb. The honey looks like it can magically heal you.`w
honey_success: `2The bees attack, but the honey tastes fantastic and restores you completely!`w
honey_smoke_success: `2You smoke out the bees with a torch. You find delicious honey and even a gem!`w
honey_smoke_fail: `4The dry tree suddenly catches fire! You have to jump down with burning clothes!`w
mushroom_ring_desc: `gYou see a ring of mushrooms with a purple vapor. You hear a hypnotic whispering...`w
mushroom_success: `2You hear the laughter of elves. When the vapor clears, you feel lighter and faster than ever!`w
mushroom_fail: `4A bright flash blinds you! You become exhausted and injured by nasty hallucinations.`w
mushroom_destroy: `2You smash the mushrooms and find gold pieces left behind by previous travelers.`w
hunters_target_desc: `gA hunter steps out of the bushes. 'Oops! I thought you were a boar. Shall we have a shooting match?'`w
hunter_success: `2BULLSEYE! The hunter whistles in awe and gives you a lucky gem.`w
hunter_fail: `4You miss the target by miles. The hunter laughs out loud. 'Better stick to your sword, friend!'`w
hunter_demand: `2The hunter sighs, throws a small pouch of gold at your feet and disappears quickly.`w
warrior_statue_title: The Statue of the Old Hero
warrior_statue_desc: `gA stone statue of a warrior holds a mossy shield. 'Offer gold to the fallen for strength.'`w
statue_offer: `2The statue trembles and a warm energy pulls through your weapon. You feel the strength of the ancestors!`w
statue_clean: `2You scrape away the moss. A sunbeam falls on the statue and you suddenly feel blessed.`w
poachers_snare_desc: `gCRACK! You are pulled upside down into the air! The poachers are coming to check their catch...`w
snare_escape: `2You cut yourself loose quickly and flee into the bushes just before the poachers arrive!`w
snare_force_success: `2With a wild jerk you break the rope! You land hard, but you are free and run away.`w
snare_force_fail: `4The rope cuts painfully. The poachers find you, laugh at you and rob you of your gold.`w
hermit_desc:
`gBetween the dense vegetation you see a small, camouflaged hut. A bone-old hermit with a long beard sits in front of the door on a log.`w

"Ah, young traveler," he speaks with a creaking voice. "You are far from the Town Square. Drink a cup of herbal tea with me. It will refresh your weary legs instantly!"
hermit_success: `2You drink the bitter herbal tea. A wave of intense energy shoots through your legs! You get +3 extra turns for today.`w
